snippet.title: Chained Beasts | Official Release Date & Platforms Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Chained Beasts is coming to PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch and Game Pass on October 15!

Wishlist and play the demo now: http://s.team/a/3569420

Chained Beasts is a 1-4 player co-op gladiator roguelike. Fight chaotic battles chained to your friends. Use your chains or the arena to beat up foes in creative ways and win over the bloodthirsty crowd. Endure physical and mental injuries to defeat fearsome bosses and survive the day.
